name: Virtual Memory for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A technique to render 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes that exceed available GPU memory by loading Gaussians into pages and streaming them to a limited buffer based on visibility and distance.
summary: Virtual Memory for 3D Gaussian Splatting enables rendering large scenes on limited GPUs by grouping Gaussians into pages, using a proxy mesh for visibility culling, and streaming only visible pages to maintain stable frame rates.
